items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: The first week that Georgie Raft (PHONETIC) came in town, the first place he came out to was Sebastian's Cotton Club.

ctx.x: It was A real place to get talent, right? the movie people came down and hired the band for I mean, (inaudible). the Showcase, right?

Oh, it was -- all the movie people of Hollywood came to Sebastian's Cotton Club at one time or the other. The first week that Georgie Raft (PHONETIC) came in town, the first place he came out to was Sebastian's Cotton Club. Texas Guinan (PHONETIC) had sent for him. He was sup-

posed to have been the take-off of the day on Rudolph Valentino, but he was too short. That's what he was brought out for. He was a ballroom dancer and they brought him out. He used to come out there all the time. All the movie stars, the Bennett Sisters, all the Talmadge Sisters, Norma and Constance, they used to come out there. Just about everybody that you could think of that was in big time show business came to Sebastian's Cotton Club because it was the biggest nightclub in the world, sizewise and it had…
